name: r4-factory-first-stage-205
budget_rationale: Complete R3 first factory stage (1312 operations, 18 SE groups) in the complete 205-carrier world. No truncation, no algorithm-predecessor execution claim. Prior four-patch 224-operation joint window took 35.65 seconds under the independent observer; larger full-world geometry and 1312-operation input receive 3000 seconds enforced compile/refinement time, 3600 seconds supervision including fixed dependency setup, 16 GiB sampled tree RSS, one worker. Search-expansions is recorded, not an infeasibility bound. This is a measured step toward adaptive factory/T consumption and full Shor.
